results.question: Is near-future cross-sectional differentiation capacity partially predictable?
results.key_finding: Current ELEC_XS_MAD_1 is the only prespecified predictor with temporally stable sign; +1 frozen IQR current MAD predicts about +11.66 bps/day average future 20-session cross-sectional MAD. SYNC_Z and RV_Z are not temporally stable.
results.limit: This predicts raw differentiation capacity, not which stocks will outperform.

results.question: Does that opportunity capacity condition the frozen MOM20 Top-5 selection edge?
results.key_finding: After controlling frozen Market State, neither Normal nor Stress MAD slope significantly predicts MOM20 H20 excess; no significant state interaction.
results.limit: High raw differentiation cannot be promoted into a MOM20 capacity gate.

results.question: Does one-week stability of the MOM20 full cross-sectional ordering predict future MOM20 rank IC?
results.key_finding: RANK_PERSIST5 has no significant state-specific slope or interaction; early/late Normal slope changes sign.
results.limit: No lag/threshold/top-k overlap rescue is allowed after seeing this null.

cross_result_inference: Raw cross-sectional dispersion and exploitable ranking alpha are distinct objects in Taiwan electronics.
Stress can contain elevated raw differentiation while frozen MOM20 loses selection edge; therefore 'there is movement' is not equivalent to 'the ranking knows the winners'.
One-week full-rank stability is also insufficient to identify when MOM20 ranking quality will persist.
The strongest surviving signal from this round remains frozen Market State's relation to MOM20 failure, not a new opportunity-capacity or persistence gate.

descriptive_transition_observation.warning: These categories use future path labels and are ex-post descriptive only, not real-time predictors.

frozen_failures_no_rescue: High/current MAD as a direct MOM20 edge conditioner
RANK_PERSIST5 as a future rank-IC conditioner
SYNC_Z as a stable opportunity-capacity predictor
RV_Z as a stable opportunity-capacity predictor

This is NOT authorized or tested by this current state.
